variables.label: Root-zone soil moisture
variables.definition: Water held in the soil down to the roots (up to 1 m in GLDAS Noah), as millimetres of water.
variables.nature_label: Land-surface model driven by observed weather and precipitation — simulated, not measured
variables.citation: Beaudoing, H. and M. Rodell, NASA/GSFC/HSL (2020), GLDAS Noah Land Surface Model L4 monthly 0.25 x 0.25 degree V2.1, Greenbelt, Maryland, USA, Goddard Earth Sciences Data and Information Services Center (GES DISC), doi:10.5067/SXAVCZFAQLNO. Accessed through the NASA Giovanni time-series service.
